test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are 6 contestants in a beauty pageant. Model Q is taller than model A but shorter than model E. Model X is not as tall as model E but is taller than model I. Model F is taller than model I but shorter than model Q. Who among the following is the tallest?
solution:
**Given: **There are 6 contestants in a beauty pageant. 

1) Q is taller than model A but shorter than model E.

E > Q > A 

2) Model X is not as tall as model E but is taller than model I.

E > X > I

3) Model F is taller than model I but shorter than model Q.

Q > F > I

So, combining all we get:

Case 1) X Q > A /F > I 

Case 2) E > Q > A /F > I 

In both cases, E is the tallest among all.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
